meta_home_title: Notebook — notes that are always at hand
meta_home_description: Write things down in the browser, on Android and iOS. One account, the same notes everywhere.
site_description: Notes in the browser, on Android and iOS — one account, the same notes everywhere.
footer_note: Built with dark-expo: Bun, Hono, Expo and React Native.
hero_title: Notes that are always at hand
hero_lead: Jot a thought down on your phone, refine it at your desk. One account, the same notes in the browser, on Android and iOS.
hero_sample_2_body: Start with a question, not a definition.
feature_1_body: The same code runs natively on Android and iOS and in the browser. There is no lesser version.
feature_2_body: Every note belongs to an account. Nobody else can see or change it.
feature_3_body: Title, text, save. Edit in place, without jumping between screens.
step_1_body: An email and a password is all it takes.
step_2_body: A title is required, the rest is up to you.
step_3_body: Log in on another device and keep writing.
faq_1_a: This is the template's demo app. Accounts are free.
faq_2_a: In an SQLite database on the app's server, with a nightly backup.
faq_3_a: Yes. Deleting is immediate and cannot be undone.
cta_title: Your first note takes a minute
cta_body: Create an account and write down what you are thinking about right now.
about_body: This is the demo app of the dark-expo template. It shows the whole slice: an account with login, data owned by the user and tests at every level — from validation to browser scenarios.
